## Final owner-review gate

Before freeze, the scientific owner must:

1. review the complete candidate packet and issue a separate approval/freeze
   decision.

The first review gate is resolved: on `2026-08-23`, Grant Wilson approved the

The second review gate is also resolved: on `2026-08-23`, Grant Wilson

Until the final complete-packet approval and freeze are issued, r0.4 remains
